title: Ignite! The Fire of Promises and Passion!

text_block_list.text: string

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wake up unusually early, but my morning
brain can't come up with
anything to do,
so I just head to my office early. On the
way there,
though...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
OH! You're the trainer I met in the hallway
the other day! This is
sudden, but are you
free right now?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If you wouldn't mind, could you help me
with my morning practice? I
know this is
out of nowhere, but please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's working this hard first thing in the morning, and I am free, so I let her sweep me into an impromptu training session.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
HAAAH! Get fired up for the red-hot
training routine! Step five!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Push those limits! Unleash a storm of
squats!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
TYAAAAAH! Get that blood boiling for a
red-hot step ten!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Now make those muscles burn—we're
doing hyper-galactic knee-ups!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
DRAAAAH! The fire's still blazing strong!
Red-hot routine, STEP
FIFTEEEEN!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm glad you asked! It's a workout my
dad taught me to get
pumped up for the
day!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
He calls it the "X-TREME RED-HOT
ROUTINE!" What do you think?
Super
cool, right?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Nope, not quite! He used to do kendo, but
now he teaches kendo
classes for
elementary schoolers. Running's a bit out
of his
wheelhouse.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That didn't stop him, though. Back in
preschool, I was super weak and
a total
scaredy cat, but Dad worked hard to train
me into who I am
now.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
He did all kinds of research on racing and
took me out to run every
single day. I love
him so much, and I've always wanted to
grow up to
be just like him!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
...And there he stood. I was face-to-face
with my old rival! We both
made it to
nationals—and to the final match of the
tournament!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text: A-and then what?! What happened next?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
A beam of light lit up the bamboo blade
we once vowed upon,
then—oops, it looks
like break time's over! The rest will have to
wait
until you've finished your own red-hot
training arc! C'mon!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Get that blood boiling for a red-hot step ten! ...And done! Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text:
Impressive. You wanted to hear the story,
but you grit your teeth and
finished
training first! Good self-discipline is a
powerful ally to any
athlete!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: If you keep working toward your goals a little each day, I promise—you will face rivals and tournaments just as exciting as mine!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I can be super patient, and I'll
practice every day! And then...
I'll be super
strong like you, Dad!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I loved hearing Dad's wild stories about
kendo, his friendship with his
rivals, and all
the competitions they went to. They filled
me with so
much inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's why I enrolled in Tracen—so I could
experience it all myself!
Meeting
life-changing rivals... and challenging them
to passionate,
red-hot duels!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: YEAH! And the thing is, I'm—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ack, it's already been this long? Sorry, I
gotta get back to the routine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We wrap up the break and I supervise the
rest of her warm-up. When
we finish, the
sun's fully up and other Umamusume are
starting their
morning training.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Um, if you've still got time, I'd appreciate
a spotter for a lap around
the turf track.
How about it? Can you watch?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: HUH?! How do you know about that?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory definitely has a talent for
turf. I'm sure training on
dirt for now
wouldn't prevent her from switching down
the line.
There's no rush.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that, and I also pose the question
that's been on my mind:
why is she so
fixated on running turf at the Tracen
Meet?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that? Don't worry, it's actually pretty
simple! I want—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Whoooosh!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory's train of thought is cut off by something—someone rushing past like a blast of wind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dirt blows at our feet as we stand frozen,
looking over the fence to
see a racer glide
smoothly over the neighboring lane's
dew-tipped
turf.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As though to race Oguri Cap, Bamboo
Memory takes off down the
dirt track.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Tch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Try as she may, though, hitting high
speeds on dirt takes more work
than on
turf. Oguri Cap's lead grows and grows...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I won't... lose!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Not to my... rival!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the massive gap between them,
Bamboo Memory continues
charging after
Oguri Cap, running the full track.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey, uh... Sorry I took off like that without
answering your question.
See, that runner
just now—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you could tell? I mean, Oguri's
amazing, right? She's so fast!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The first time I saw her run, just bam! I knew then and there, she was the rival I was looking for.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sure of it. She's my destiny.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I want to challenge her! I want to overtake
her! Even now, I wanna run
with her so
bad, you have no idea!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So I've gotta switch tracks! Oguri's scheduled to run in the 1,600-meter turf race at the Tracen Meet, so I wanna face her there!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I know that my nails are fragile, and I
understand why my instructor
wants me to
stick to dirt. I do trust her opinion, and I'm
trying to
follow all her advice, but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's just, I can't help it. My head
understands, but my heart wants to
run.
Ever since meeting Oguri, I can tell—she's
a part of my story!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can feel her passion. I know in my heart that nothing will stop Bamboo Memory now. She looks like a model student on the surface, but deep down, running's the only thing on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wish I could see what inspires her so...
And my curiosity won't
smoulder away
until I'm at her side, experiencing it all
with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's too late to go back—I'm already part
of Bamboo Memory's story
too.
